A. Fixture Array Sum
time limit per test1 second
memory limit per test256 megabytes

For each array, print the sum of its elements.

Input

The first integer is $$$t$$$ (1 ≤ t ≤ 5). Each case contains n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000), then n integers (-100 ≤ a_i ≤ 100). The sum of n across cases is at most 2000.

Output

Print one integer per case.

Input
2
3
1 2 3
1
-100
Output
6
-100
Note

The answer is unique.
